title: Colorado Karting Circuit at Centennial Airport
specs: Professionally designed circuit with wide lanes, tight corners, and high-speed straights
High-performance rental karts maintained for speed and safety
Junior karts available for ages 8 to 12 with training
Bronze Rental License required for rental bookings
No rental kart drivers under age 13
2-Seater driver must be 18 or older; passenger at least 8 years old and 42 inches tall
Junior drivers must be 8 to 12 years old and complete training course
Drivers must wear same-day issued wristband on wrist
Helmets and appropriate safety gear must be worn at all times
No alcohol or drugs allowed on premises

blurb: Guests can race rental karts, bring their own karts for owner karting, or participate in professional race series. The circuit offers high-performance karts, safety gear, and a professionally designed track. Junior karts and 2-seater karts are available for younger or shared experiences.
extraNote: Memberships are non transferable and non refundable, valid 365 days from purchase · Wristbands required for everyone on property; $10 for spectators and mechanics · No sharing or tampering of wristbands; violation results in suspension · No entry to track or hot pit except by staff
